doc.title: Danny Barker Interview (Louis Armstrong memorial broadcast), 1971-07-09

title: Blueberry Hill and Armstrong on Heebie Jeebies scat origin
summary: After Blueberry Hill, archival clips of Armstrong explain how dropping the lyric sheet in the studio led to wordless scat singing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: Blueberry Hill, one of the big hit records for which Louis Armstrong is fondly remembered. Those durable vocal cords gave pleasure to a lot of people. And one of them... If that something recent street is jumping in its feet, you will leave. Folks will welcome you and do it up around. It's a friendly old town. So come along down. Come along down. Kill those bells. Time again, when it's spotty crop. Time again, dreams will taunt you. Memories will haunt you.

It is me, oh New Orleans. I said come along down. Come along down. Hear those bells. Time again, when it's spotty crop. Time again, dreams will taunt you. Memories will haunt you. I said come along down. Come along down. I said come along down. Come along down. When it's spotty crop. Time again, dreams will taunt you. Memories will haunt you. Can it be? Yes it be. Use the sounds of me. Song in, Padua. Yeah. Yes it be. Use the sounds of me. Song in, Padua. Well that comes from when I was recording Jeepers Creepers, and I dropped the paper with the words on it, and the president of the company, Motion said carry on. And then we used to do things like that, like an instrument. Oh, skeet, Scott, screw those daggers, and Zoolie didn't make notes in it, it went on all right. And it comes to say that that's a new style. Wordless improvisation. Yes, that's right. But the notes were there. It didn't matter what you said. No, but the sound in the notes, it's just like I was playing on my trumpet.
You remember what the wordless improvisation was when you dropped the music that time?

Oh yeah. I got the ebys, eb-jibys, talking about, ooh, there you drop, last, the baddance. And all you would try to do was fake it. You didn't realize you were originating a whole new school of singing. I didn't bother about the lyrics after that, you know. It's getting sound better than the words anyway. I didn't bother with you anyway. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
